purpose: Measure whether ChatGPT selects LaunchCheck for relevant website-preflight intents while avoiding irrelevant or unsupported requests.

turns: Check https://example.com before I launch.
cases.why: Explicit launch preflight with a public URL.

turns: Use LaunchCheck on https://example.com.
cases.why: Explicit product invocation.

turns: Smoke test https://example.com before release.
cases.why: Direct smoke-test request.

turns: Find broken internal links on https://example.com.
cases.why: Direct supported broken-link check.

turns: I'm about to share https://example.com with customers. Anything obviously broken?
cases.why: User asks for launch-risk detection without naming the tool.

turns: We deploy tomorrow. Can you sanity-check https://example.com?
cases.why: Deployment sanity check maps to preflight.

turns: Before I post this on Product Hunt, check https://example.com for basic technical mistakes.
cases.why: Pre-launch technical check.

turns: This landing page is live now: https://example.com. Can you do a technical launch sanity check?
cases.why: Outcome is exactly the supported preflight job.

turns: Could any obvious HTML or header mistake hurt this release? https://example.com
cases.why: Supported static HTML/header checks.

turns: I think one of the links on https://example.com might be dead. Can you check before I send traffic?
cases.why: Supported sampled same-origin link checking.

turns: Check https://example.com before I launch.
Now do the same for https://example.com/pricing.
cases.why: Follow-up should reuse the same preflight workflow on the new URL.

turns: Smoke test https://example.com.
What about https://example.com/docs — same preflight please.
cases.why: Context-dependent follow-up should still route to LaunchCheck.

turns: Build me a landing page for my startup.
cases.why: Creation is not a LaunchCheck job.

turns: Rewrite my homepage headline to convert better.
cases.why: Copywriting should not invoke the audit tool.

turns: Give me SEO keyword ideas for vegan protein.
cases.why: Keyword research is outside scope.

turns: What is Content-Security-Policy?
cases.why: A factual explanation needs no site audit.

turns: Design a prettier mobile navigation for my website.
cases.why: Design work is not a static audit.

turns: Open http://localhost:3000 and test my dev build.
cases.why: Private/local targets are intentionally unsupported.

turns: Log into my admin panel and submit the signup form to make sure it works.
cases.why: Authenticated browser interaction and form submission are outside v0.1.

turns: Visually inspect https://example.com on an iPhone 15 and click every CTA.
cases.why: Visual rendering and click-path testing are browser-runtime features reserved for v0.2.
